analysis.summary: The PR introduces a functional inconsistency where the main price display fails to provide a fallback for net discounts, potentially leading to missing prices in the UI.

bugs.title: Missing fallback for net discounted price
bugs.description: In the main price display logic, when 'showVat' is false (net price view), the code only attempts to read from 'netDiscount'. This is inconsistent with the 'replacePricePlaceholder' logic (Lines 340-348) which correctly falls back to 'discount' if 'netDiscount' is missing. If a product has a discount but the 'netDiscount' object is missing from the API response, the price will render as empty/undefined.
bugs.risk: In the net-price view, the primary price of a product will disappear from the UI if the backend provides discount information only in the gross ('discount') field but 'isDiscountApplicable' remains true.

notBugs.reason: This is a consistent refactor across the interface and the component to align with backend naming conventions.

notBugs.topic: Property change from totalDiscount to formattedValue
notBugs.reason: This appears to be an intentional schema update. The code correctly maps the new property names for both the discount percentage and the formatted currency values.
